title: Frontend Lead overhaul for the complete StarCraft Web/App product journey

verification.name: focused navigation and character presentation components
verification.command: corepack pnpm@9.12.0 --dir apps/starcraft-tmg-expo exec vitest run lib/level3/__tests__/battlefield-presentation-v1.test.ts lib/level3/__tests__/character-presentation-mount-v2.test.tsx

taskBrief: Own a frontend-only refinement program for Ticket 20 Slices 193-195. Preserve every current capability and every backend interface. First audit the actual Expo Web/App routes, navigation, battle table, Database, army builder, calculators, review/Skill and Settings surfaces, then write and freeze a numbered sub-slice plan in docs/ticket-20-slices-193-195-frontend-lead-v1-2026-09-21.md. Implement the plan as separate scoped commits. The target is a cohesive StarCraft command-interface experience that remains practical for tabletop players: the battle table must remain the visual focus; secondary panels must be reachable without a long scrolling page; unit identity, stats, upgrades, reserve/deploy state, score projections, tokens, threat modes and action feedback must be legible; Database, builder, calculator, battle and review journeys must have clear navigation; layouts must adapt to desktop Web, narrow Web and touch-first App screens; and accessibility/reduced-motion behavior must remain intact. Reuse existing StarCraft-style art, portraits, map assets and visual tokens, improving presentation-only composition where needed. Do not change Client Domain, Rules, Authority, room, Provider, memory, source data or API contracts. Do not remove operations merely because their backend is incomplete; retain them with honest disabled/loading/error states. Run only the two named focused gates under the profile's self-verification policy, record receipts in the closure document, commit each completed sub-slice, and do not push.
